solutions.title: Swap permutations with set
solutions.strategy: Generate every index permutation by swapping and store value rows in a set to collapse duplicates.

timeComplexity.explanation: All index permutations may be generated and each copied row costs linear time.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The dedupe set may store every unique row plus recursion stack.

solutions.title: Sorted used-array backtracking
solutions.strategy: Sort values and skip a duplicate value when its previous equal value has not been used in the current branch.

timeComplexity.explanation: `a` unique permutations are emitted and each row costs `n` to copy.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Ignoring output, only the path, used flags, and recursion stack are stored.
